notes: Wearable powered exoskeleton for a 1.75 m adult: 17 actuated joints (trunk, 2x hip ab/flex, knee, ankle, 2x shoulder ab/flex, elbow, wrist), lateral struts, strap cuffs, joint actuator modules, 9 kg power/compute back pack, insole force sensors, trunk IMU, HUD camera. The wearer is added in simulation (ttr_mujoco --wearer). Thrusters are mount points, not modelled propulsion.
Interpreted by demo parser: type inferred, DOF=17, gripper=parallel.
metadata.source_prompt: Build me a real wearable Iron Man suit: a powered exoskeleton with repulsor thrusters, a HUD camera and an IMU
